decisions.reason: The source supports explaining validation failures to warehouse supervisors and describes sitting beside a supervisor to work through a workflow example.

The source supports writing the handbook and documenting Roster Note, but the claim that 12 coworkers were trained conflicts with a later attendance sheet listing 14; the source says this discrepancy cannot be resolved.
The source explicitly characterizes Docker as a one-off exercise and does not claim broader implementation experience.
The source states the BSc, field, institution, and dates exactly as recorded.
The source states receipt of the fictional Cedar SQL Foundations certificate on 2020-08-15 and clarifies that the certificate was course completion, not a professional license.
The source explicitly says Ada speaks English fluently.
The source explicitly lists Python, SQL, and PostgreSQL in the Data tools skill category.
The source explicitly lists Git and coworker training in the Collaboration skill category.
